notes: 20 expansion bags x 20 foods (10 healthy grade A/B + 10 junk grade D/E) = 400 foods. The free Starter Bag is defined in PIKKO-GAME-DESIGN.md section 8.
kcal values are APPROXIMATE per typical portion and must be verified against USDA FoodData Central / CREA / IZZ tables and reviewed by a paediatric nutritionist before release.
Grades are the internal Pikko Score, not the official Nutri-Score.
Polish names need native-speaker review. No brand names or trademarks: assets must be generic.
mint is null until the developer supplies the Pump.fun CA and it passes Token-2022 / extension / route verification. Until then the bag stays in TRIAL mode.
